test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years India hosted the Women's Asia Cup ODI Cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2006**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first edition of the Women's Asia Cup in the One Day International (ODI) format was held in 2004.
 
• Sri Lanka had the honor of hosting the inaugural tournament.
 
• Only two teams participated in the first edition: India and Sri Lanka.
 
• The tournament in 2004 was played as a five-match ODI series.
 
• India emerged victorious in the inaugural Women's Asia Cup, winning all five matches against Sri Lanka.
 
• The second edition of the Women's Asia Cup in ODI format took place in the years 2005-06.
 
• Pakistan hosted the second edition of the tournament.
 
• Three teams competed in the 2005-06 edition: India, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• India continued their dominance, winning the tournament by defeating Sri Lanka in the final.
 
• The third edition of the Women's Asia Cup in the ODI format was hosted by India in 2006.
 
• This tournament also featured three teams: India, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• All the matches of the 2006 Women's Asia Cup were played at the Sawai Mansingh Stadium in Jaipur.
 
• India secured their third consecutive Women's Asia Cup title by defeating Sri Lanka in the final by eight wickets.
 
• The fourth edition of the Women's Asia Cup in ODI format was held in 2008.
 
• Sri Lanka hosted the 2008 edition, which saw the participation of four teams with the inclusion of Bangladesh.
 
• India won their fourth successive title by defeating Sri Lanka in the final.
 
• After 2008, the Women's Asia Cup transitioned to the Twenty20 International (T20I) format.
 
• India has been the most successful team in the Women's Asia Cup, having won the title multiple times in both ODI and T20I formats.
